items.title: Robotics Foundations: Sensors, Motion and Control
items.excerpt: A hands-on introduction to sensors, actuators, Arduino control, and reliable robot motion for student builders.
items.content: This workshop guided students through sensor wiring, actuator control, simple feedback loops, and safe robot testing. Participants finished with a small obstacle-avoidance prototype and a clearer path from a physical problem to a working control system.

items.title: Applied AI for STEM Projects
items.excerpt: A practical session on turning datasets into useful engineering decisions with Python and machine learning.
items.content: Students explored data preparation, model evaluation, and responsible interpretation through a compact engineering prediction exercise. The session connected software experimentation with measurable physical-world outcomes.
